summary: Frontend-only verification of the new admin 'Actualizar fechas Envío a Imple' button on /projects (backfill of sent_to_implementation_at). All three sub-tests passed: button visible for admin with correct testid, window.confirm + sonner toast flow works (idempotent info toast: 'Todos los proyectos ya tienen la fecha…'), button returns to idle state, and the button is correctly hidden for the no-admin user (srubio) who has read access to /projects.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing (not related to this change): React hydration warning in Projects.jsx (table) and Dashboard.jsx (commitments table) — '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' / '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>'. Caused by the visual-editor wrapper <span data-ve-dynamic style={display:'contents'}> placed inside <tbody>. Should be addressed in a future cleanup as it produces console noise on every render.
Pre-existing (not related to this change): WebSocket connection to /api/ws/notifications fails to establish (closed before open) in Preview environment. Reported in previous iterations.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backfill button verified end-to-end on Preview. Admin sees the amber button labeled 'Actualizar fechas Envío a Imple' (data-testid='backfill-impl-date-btn') in the /projects header next to 'Reporte Carga (PDF)'. Clicking triggers window.confirm with the correct Spanish copy; accepting calls POST /api/projects/backfill-impl-date and a sonner toast appears. In this run the toast was the idempotent 'Todos los proyectos ya tienen la fecha de Envío a Implementación. No hubo cambios.' (expected — backend reports 0 updated). Button correctly hidden for srubio (no-admin). To exercise the success branch, a seeded project with sent_to_implementation_at=null would be needed.
